title: Resume on a head withheld for "retained authorization requires reconciliation" (superseded authority image) returns 200 and changes nothing
outcome: When a queued head's admission binding fails with control_unavailable 'named-root acknowledgement belongs to a superseded authority image', and the host withholds automatic continuation because 'retained authorization requires reconciliation', a Resume (POST /api/sessions/{id}/queue/resume) either reconciles and starts the head, delivered at most once, or returns a conflict naming the reconciliation needed. It is never a 200 that leaves the session idle and paused with no result. Agents are told whether an automatic retry is pending.
acceptance: The holder's note names, with file:line locators, the code path in resume_local_session_queue_inner and its callees (session_lifecycle.rs:475-615) that returns 200 without promoting the head or refusing, for the observed record state: head engramInterrupted=true, isEngramRetained=true, and last card admission_binding control_unavailable 'superseded authority image' with continuation withheld. It also says how that state arose (the 2026-10-20 13:48:22Z occurrence on session-11330).
A fail-first test reproduces that record state and shows that today's Resume returns success while queuePaused stays true and no durable result is recorded.

With the fix, the Resume either reconciles and starts the retained head (delivered at most once), or returns a typed conflict whose text names the reconciliation step, and the session record shows a durable, visible outcome. Tests cover both, plus the unchanged path where an automatic retry is already scheduled.
The full five-stage gate passes on the exact committed tree, and an independent review pair has no outstanding in-scope Medium-or-higher finding.
